services.name: prokrust.api.v1alpha1.CatalogService
services.description:
Manage workspace definitions, storage setup, snapshots, and activity in a customer cluster.
Calls use the caller’s Kubernetes identity and workspace permissions. Some compatibility
methods authenticate and then return unimplemented.

methods.name: CreateSnapshotBuild
methods.description:
Create a SnapshotBuild in the workspace from its complete Kubernetes spec. Copy the target
UID and data request digest from the snapshot. Choose the ordinal for this build attempt.

methods.name: GetSnapshotBuild
methods.description:
Read the named SnapshotBuild in one workspace. Compare generation with
status.observedGeneration when interpreting a controller result.

methods.name: ListSnapshotBuilds
methods.description:
List SnapshotBuild resources in one workspace. Pass nextPageToken back as pageToken to
continue the same listing.

methods.name: WatchSnapshotBuild
methods.description:
Stream the initial SnapshotBuild and subsequent modifications or deletion. Supply the UID to
detect a same-name replacement. Each response is one event.

methods.name: CancelSnapshotBuild
methods.description:
Request cancellation of the pinned build. The disposition distinguishes a new request, an
already terminal build, and a build that began committing.

methods.name: DeleteSnapshotBuild
methods.description:
Request deletion of the exact SnapshotBuild identified by UID and resource version.
ReviewDeletion reports dependencies and permissions before deletion.

methods.name: ListSnapshotBuildLogTargets
methods.description:
List containers in pods owned by the workflow for this SnapshotBuild. Choose one returned
pod and container for StreamSnapshotBuildLogs.

methods.name: StreamSnapshotBuildLogs
methods.description:
Stream log lines for one verified SnapshotBuild workflow pod and container. Select the
target with ListSnapshotBuildLogTargets. Each response contains one line.

methods.name: RetrySnapshot
methods.description:
Create or recover the SnapshotBuild for one retry request on a pinned snapshot. Reuse the
same request ID when retrying the same API call.

methods.name: CancelSnapshotPreparation
methods.description: Request cancellation of the preparation. Read its status to follow child cleanup.

methods.name: ListActivities
methods.description:
List workspace activity roots, with optional kind and state filters. Use the returned
references to inspect one activity graph.

methods.name: GetActivity
methods.description:
Read a page of nodes and edges for one exact activity root. Inspect incomplete and
unavailableReason when permissions or missing objects limit the graph.

methods.name: GetActivityExecution
methods.description:
Read the Argo workflow linked to an activity owner. Supply workflowRef to pin the observed
workflow. The response can carry an unavailability reason before an execution exists. The
example shows a request made before a workflow reference exists.

methods.name: GetTableSnapshotProfile
methods.description:
Read verified full-snapshot statistics using the current snapshot UID. Bind displayed counts
or time bounds to the returned manifest digest.

methods.name: ListSnapshotHistory
methods.description:
Count or page through snapshots for one parent, or request orphaned snapshots of one kind. A
zero page size returns counts.

Update the owning Helm or GitOps configuration when it manages this resource. The example
changes the target partition count.

methods.name: GetNamespaceSetup

methods.name: CreateArtifactStore

methods.name: GetArtifactStore

methods.name: CreateProkrustPolicy

methods.name: GetProkrustPolicy
methods.description:
Read the named ProkrustPolicy in one workspace. Compare generation with
status.observedGeneration when interpreting a controller result. The response example uses
synthetic image digests and identities. Use the values resolved in your installation.

methods.name: UpdateProkrustPolicy
methods.description:
Replace the complete ProkrustPolicy spec. Read the object first and send its current UID and
resource version. Fields omitted from spec are removed or defaulted by Kubernetes. Update
the owning Helm or GitOps configuration when it manages this resource. Copy the installed
spec first. The sample image digests and service accounts illustrate its shape. The example
changes the per-endpoint replica ceiling.

services.name: prokrust.api.v1alpha1.ProviderCatalogService
services.description:
Discover the installed connector descriptors, manage their registered connection resources,
and invoke supported discovery operations on a pinned connection. Calls use the caller’s
workspace access. Source discovery requires an enabled provider and an authorized
connection.

methods.name: ListConnectorProviders
methods.description:
Discover providers visible in a workspace. Use each registered connection type and selector
schema to build subsequent requests. The example shows selected provider metadata. The full
descriptor includes schemas and capabilities.

methods.name: CreateSourceConnection
methods.description:
Create a descriptor-registered connection. Encode its complete JSON spec as UTF-8 bytes,
then base64 for ProtoJSON. Use the schema from ListConnectorProviders. Use
ListConnectorProviders for the registered group, version, and kind. Disabled providers
reject creation.

methods.name: GetSourceConnection
methods.description: Read a registered connection by exact API version, kind, namespace, and name.

methods.name: ListSourceConnections
methods.description:
List one registered connection type in a workspace. Continue using the token returned by
Kubernetes.

methods.name: DeleteSourceConnection
methods.description:
Request deletion of the registered connection using the UID and resource version from a
current read. Returns deletionRequested after Kubernetes accepts foreground deletion with
both preconditions.

methods.name: ProbeSourceConnection
methods.description:
Run the enabled provider’s access probe against the pinned connection. Decode responseJson
as UTF-8 connector ProtoJSON. The example decodes to a positive usability result. The
connection UID must still match the caller-readable object.

methods.name: BrowseConnectorSources
methods.description:
Browse one bounded page of sources. Omit parent to browse the root. Pass a returned token
back as opaque bytes. The example decodes to a selectable events entry.

methods.name: InspectConnectorSource
methods.description:
Inspect one source using the selector version and configuration advertised by the enabled
provider. The example decodes to selected metadata from the Synthetic connector.

services.name: prokrust.connector.v1.ConnectorService
services.description:
Implement this service in a provider’s connection runtime. Prokrust calls it over Connect
with mutual TLS, using a workspace planner or executor identity. The Web API handles
customer access to connections. Examples use one synthetic connection, illustrative
artifact bindings and sample deadlines. Actual scan calls copy the IDs, references,
limits and selectors issued by the platform.

methods.name: GetRuntimeInfo
methods.description:
Read the identity and admission state of one runtime replica. A planner or executor may
call this method. Check the reported release and capabilities before dispatching work.

methods.name: ProbeConnection
methods.description:
Check whether a resolved connection is usable. The workspace planner supplies a
deadline and budget. Inspect diagnostics when usable is false.

methods.name: BrowseSources
methods.description:
List potential source selectors for the connection. The planner omits the parent for
the first level and passes back a continuation token to fetch another page.

methods.name: InspectSource
methods.description:
Ask the provider for available schema, formats and estimates before staging rows. The
example inspects the synthetic events dataset. Compare source observation time with
collection time.

methods.name: PlanScan
methods.description:
Have the planner resolve an immutable partition plan. Copy the authorization, output
prefix, budget and options from the run’s execution input. The server can stream
progress before the final completed plan reference. The response example shows that
final event.

methods.name: StagePartition
methods.description:
Stage one adopted partition using the workspace executor identity and its
platform-issued grant. The stream can report progress before the completed receipt. The
response example shows the receipt reference, which the platform uses to adopt the
output.

methods.name: ReleaseScan
methods.description:
Have the planner release upstream resources identified by an adopted plan. To clean up
an abandoned attempt, supply its execution input and select the abandoned-planning
target after the attempt deadline and grace period.

services.name: prokrust.license.v1alpha1.LicenseRuntimeService
services.description:
Operator licensing client for customer installations. Calls go to the configured vendor
runtime over TLS. Each challenge proof is bound to one operation. Examples show symbolic
signatures and entitlements. Generate proofs from the actual challenge and installation keys.

methods.name: GetChallenge
methods.description:
Request a nonce for one operation and installation. This example starts a renewal. For
initial activation supply the activation credential and publish the TXT record returned by
the server.

methods.name: VerifyDNS
methods.description:
Check the TXT record before completing activation. Sign the activate challenge with the
installation key. Successful verification lets the operator proceed to Activate using the
same proof.

methods.name: Activate
methods.description:
Claim an activation slot and obtain a signed capacity entitlement after DNS verification. An
identical retry of a completed challenge returns the cached result.

installation key proves possession. DNS changes and the bootstrap credential are
unnecessary.

current installation key.

methods.name: Deactivate
methods.description: Release an activation slot. Sign a deactivate challenge before retiring the installation.

methods.name: RotateKey

services.name: prokrust.profile.v1.TableProfileService
services.description:
Start, read and cancel profiles through the Web API in the customer cluster. These are
unary Connect calls scoped to the authenticated caller and workspace. Send Connect JSON
with Content-Type application/json and Connect-Protocol-Version 1. A browser uses its
signed-in session. API clients authenticate with a Kubernetes bearer token. Providers
supply source access through ConnectorService.

methods.name: StartTableProfile
methods.description:
Start profiling a Table recipe in the caller’s workspace. The example inspects metadata
for a synthetic events connection and uses event_id as the primary key. Use the actual
connection UID, a freshly dated idempotency key and a future deadline within ten
minutes. ProtoJSON encodes selector and recipe JSON bytes in base64. An identical retry
with the same key returns the original profile UID.

methods.name: GetTableProfile
methods.description:
Read the state and available results for the caller’s profile. Use the UID returned by
StartTableProfile. A queued profile can be polled until it reaches a terminal state.

methods.name: CancelTableProfile
methods.description:
Request cancellation of an outstanding profile. If cancellation is pending, poll
GetTableProfile until it reports a terminal state. A repeated cancellation returns the
current state.

fields.description:
Bootstrap credential issued for the license. Send it over TLS during initial activation.

fields.description:

types.name: prokrust.profile.v1.SampleSpec
types.description:
Bounds a deterministic prefix of the selected source. The prefix can differ from the
source as a whole.

fields.name: maxRows
fields.description:
Maximum converted rows to include. Zero or omission selects 10,000, which is also the
maximum.

fields.name: maxPartitions
fields.description:
Maximum plan partitions to include. Zero or omission selects 16, which is also the
maximum.

types.name: prokrust.profile.v1.ScalarValue
types.description: Preserves precision when a scalar result is represented in JSON.

fields.name: type
fields.description: Declared type used to interpret the textual value.

fields.name: value
fields.description:
Canonical exact value expressed as text. Binary values use base64 and large integers
retain all digits.

types.name: prokrust.profile.v1.StartTableProfileRequest
types.description: Authorizes an asynchronous profile with explicit time, data and cost limits.

fields.name: workspace
fields.description: Name of the workspace namespace in which the caller starts or reads the profile.

fields.name: idempotencyKey
fields.description:
Use `v1:<Unix seconds>:<lowercase UUIDv4>` dated at creation. Retry with the same key and
request body. A new key permits a separate run.

fields.name: definition
fields.description: Connection, versioned selector and Table conversion recipe to inspect.

fields.name: mode
fields.description:
Choose metadata, sample or full scan according to how much source data the caller
authorizes.

fields.name: metrics
fields.description:
Statistics to compute in sample or full-scan mode. Metadata mode requires an empty
list.

fields.name: budget
fields.description:
Absolute deadline within ten minutes, positive source-byte limit and explicit
staged-byte limit. Sample and full scan require positive staged bytes.

fields.name: sample
fields.description: Row and partition limits for sample mode.

fields.name: buckets
fields.description: UTC boundaries and width required when requesting a time-bucket metric.

fields.name: allowFullScan
fields.description:
Set true to authorize full-scan mode. Sample and metadata requests must leave this
false.

fields.name: previewRows
fields.description:
Number of converted sample rows to return for inspection, at most 100 and no more than
the sample row limit.

types.name: prokrust.profile.v1.StartTableProfileResponse
types.description: Identifies the accepted operation for subsequent reads or cancellation.

fields.name: profileUid
fields.description: UID to pass to GetTableProfile or CancelTableProfile.

fields.name: idempotencyExpiresAt
fields.description:
Time at which the idempotency key expires, 30 days after its issue time. An expired key
cannot start a new operation.

types.name: prokrust.profile.v1.TimeBuckets
types.description: Defines 1 to 512 equal-width UTC intervals for an event-time histogram.

fields.name: startInclusive
fields.description:
Beginning of the first bucket, inclusive. Use a whole-second UTC timestamp aligned to
the width since the Unix epoch.

fields.name: endExclusive
fields.description: End of the last bucket, exclusive. The range must contain a whole number of buckets.

fields.name: widthSeconds
fields.description: Positive width of each bucket in seconds.
